about: Every tool Open TAN drives, how to install it, how to sign in, and how to check it. Read by `bin/studio.mjs doctor` (law 37). One entry per tool; the agent installs, the human signs in. macOS only.
rules: Run `node bin/studio.mjs doctor` first on a new machine and at the start of any session that fails a job. Fix the core rows top to bottom; connect the others only when a job needs them.
Install with the exact command in `install`. Never swap in another tool for the same job; the ROUTER in STUDIO.md names one tool per job.
Sign-ins are the human's: the agent runs the `login` command, the human finishes it in the browser or terminal. The agent never types a password, code or card.
Keys, cookies and sessions stay in each tool's own home (~/.codex, ~/.gflow, Blender prefs) or in .env.local (git-ignored). Never in the repo, never in a prompt, never in a log.
A row is connected only when doctor shows it ready. Never start a job on a tool doctor marks not ready.
Paid things (a plan, credits, a paid CLI) are the human's decision: ask first. Google Flow spends credits: obey law 34 (x1, budget, price check, live balance).
A new CLI only when a job needs it and no row covers it: `cli-hub can "<job>"`, then ask the human, then add it here with install, login and check, and add it to the ROUTER.

tools.name: Node.js
tools.for: bin/studio.mjs, the board, the Flow scripts

tools.name: Repo packages
tools.for: the board (Next.js) and sharp (logo placement, checks)

tools.name: Python + numpy + OpenCV
tools.for: bin/unmark.py (Gemini mark off, law 28), bin/upscale.py, bin/markmap.py
tools.install: python3 -m pip install numpy opencv-python-headless   (if pip says externally-managed: brew install numpy opencv)

tools.name: ffmpeg (TAN Upscaler)
tools.for: video ingest, unmark, edit export, TAN Upscaler (law 29)

tools.name: Google Chrome
tools.for: the board opens in it; Google Flow runs in its own Chrome window

tools.name: ChatGPT (Codex CLI)
tools.for: every poster and hero still (router: ChatGPT)
tools.signin: codex login   (human: sign in with the ChatGPT account that has image generation)

tools.name: Google Flow (gflow)
tools.for: every video clip, bulk image drafts (router: Flow); credits, law 34
tools.signin: gflow auth login   (human: sign in to Google with the Flow plan in the Chrome window it opens), then node bin/studio.mjs credits

tools.name: Blender
tools.install: download Blender 5.2 LTS from blender.org into /Applications (elsewhere: set BLENDER=/path/to/Blender)
tools.signin: optional live bridge: uvx mcp-for-blender install-addon, then turn the add-on on in Blender (port 9876)

tools.name: Pinterest (pin)
tools.for: backup reference search only (law 13), logged out
tools.install: go install github.com/tamnd/pinterest-cli/cmd/pin@latest   (needs Go: brew install go)

tools.name: CLI Hub
tools.for: finding a CLI for a job no row covers
tools.install: pipx install cli-anything-hub   (pipx: brew install pipx)
